answer_1.quote: Modern MLLMs like GPT-4o (OpenAI, 2024b) and LLaVA-NeXT have exhibited remarkable proficiency across various vision-language tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering (VQA), and visual reasoning.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates MLLMs on generating answers to visual questions and reasoning about vision-knowledge conflicts, including open-ended, multiple-choice, and yes-no responses.

answer_2.quote: We use Accuracy and Memorization Ratio (MR) as the main evaluation metrics in our experiment.

answer_4.quote: For Open-Ended questions, due to the complexity of the task (i.e., evaluating both textual and visual relevance and correctness) and the instability of LLM evaluation, we rely on human annotators to perform the classification.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated responses based on relevancy (whether the response is reflected in the image and addresses the question) and responsiveness (whether the response directly answers the question). They also classified answers by semantic closeness to reference responses in Vision or Knowledge categories.
